Listed so a reviewer can see the mint was minimised rather than skipped; each th was re-read from docs/extract/i18n-full.json this round and asserted byte-exact against its .jsx line by the sidecar test. 9 of the sidecar's 16 slots (the remaining 7 are the minted set below).

_zero_mint_reused.today: dict sales.common.today 'วันนี้' — byte-identical to the axis marker label (L687, where the prototype prefixes U+2191)
_zero_mint_reused.heroLabel: dict sales.dashboard.kpiSalesCumulative 'ยอดขายสะสม' — the web sales dashboard's own cumulative-sales KPI label. See _text_deviation.heroYear: this is the prototype's L657 label MINUS its hardcoded mock year
_zero_mint_reused.unitBaht: dict subcon.unitBaht '฿' — the THB currency glyph on the approvals rows (L705). U+0E3F is a THAI codepoint, so it cannot be a Dart literal (.claude/hooks/i18n-guard.sh); the merged approvals-inbox screen resolves it through this same key. NOTE the glyph is CONDITIONAL, not the constant the prototype hardcodes: the wire row carries `currency_code` beside `amount`, so this key renders only when the server says THB; another code renders as the code itself ('645,000 USD') and a null code renders the number alone. money = SERVER applies to the unit as much as to the number — stamping a USD purchase order with a baht glyph is the same class of error as fabricating the amount

_text_deviation.heroYear: L657 reads 'ยอดขายสะสมปี 2569' and the port renders 'ยอดขายสะสม'. 2569 is a MOCK CONSTANT typed into the source — nothing computes it, and no feed supplies the figure it would qualify, so the hero value is an em-dash (BLOCKERS.md B-299). Labelling an unknown number as belonging to a specific fiscal year would assert a period the screen cannot substantiate, so the year is stripped as a mock mechanic (PLAN.md §0 rule 3) and the existing zero-mint dict id carries the rest of the label verbatim. Filed in BLOCKERS.md B-298 for a ruling: if Wei rules that reference-image fidelity wins, mint 'ยอดขายสะสมปี 2569' as a phrases key and repoint the heroLabel slot — noting that the value under it stays an em-dash either way, and that a year baked into a key will be wrong next year.

_not_minted_deliberately.yoyDelta: '+12% YoY ↑' (L661) is DROPPED, not keyed. It is a growth CLAIM, and no feed carries a year-over-year figure — the three wired endpoints return budget KPIs, an approvals list and an EVM series. Note the dict ALREADY holds a template for it (dashboard.tplDeltaYoY '+{p}% YoY') and it is deliberately NOT used: rendering it requires a p that does not exist, and a template with an em-dashed placeholder ('+—% YoY ↑') would still assert a direction. The sidecar test forbids any slot resolving to text containing 'YoY'.
_not_minted_deliberately.headerEyebrow: 'ผอ.สมพร เพชรชัย' (L650) is mock DATA, not a key — a person's name. AppServices exposes a bearer token, not a user profile, so there is no honest current-user name to render; the eyebrow is omitted (the merged sales-crm precedent, whose header drops the same salesperson eyebrow).
_not_minted_deliberately.rowApproveLabel: 'อนุมัติ' (L708) is DROPPED, not keyed — and note it WOULD have been zero-mint (phrases 'อนุมัติ' and dict common.approve both exist), so this is a scope decision, not an i18n one. It labels a green one-tap APPROVE button on every approvals row. This screen is read-only: it originates no write, holds no approval-tier logic, and the merged approve/reject sheets own that action. A button that names an approval it does not perform is a promise, so it is dropped rather than rendered inert. The sidecar test forbids any slot resolving to 'อนุมัติ'. BLOCKERS.md B-299 files it for a ruling.
_not_minted_deliberately.legendPercents: '65%' (L690) and '62%' (L691) are mock literals, not keys. Percent-complete in EVM is EV/BAC, and BAC is a REAL stored column (packages/db/src/schema/finance.ts L922) that loadEvmSeries already loads (apps/api/src/routes/evm-series.ts L49) — but GET /boq/reports/evm does not put it in its response body (it returns series/spi/cpi/currency_code). So the legend labels ship over em-dashes. B-299 files the one-field response gap.
_not_minted_deliberately.kpiValues: '-18.4' / '17' / '3' / '54.2' (L666-669) and '284.5 M ฿' / '148/240' (L658/L660) are mock DATA, not keys. Every one of them renders as an em-dash — see exec_agg.dart ExecKpis for the per-slot verified reason and BLOCKERS.md B-299.
_not_minted_deliberately.axisMonths: 'ม.ค.' / 'พ.ค.' / 'ส.ค.' (L687) are mock literals and are NOT minted as month names. The axis now renders the SERVER's own period_label ('YYYY-MM', the real first and last plotted periods), so there is nothing to translate: a Thai month-abbreviation table would be new copy AND would have to invent a mapping the wire does not ask for.
